subject: Biology
question: In a population, 16% of individuals show the recessive phenotype. Use the Hardy–Weinberg equation to estimate the percentage of heterozygous carriers.
response_text:
q² = 0.16, so q = √0.16 = 0.4
p = 1 − q = 1 − 0.4 = 0.6
Carriers: 2pq = 2 × 0.6 × 0.4 = 0.48

So about 48% of the population are heterozygous carriers.
